skill_name: Write a persuasive essay on why people should get a pet.
workflow: Pets have countless benefits to offer the people that own them. For one, they can provide unconditional love and companionship no matter the circumstances. People with pets often feel a sense of purpose and belonging in the world. Furthermore, pets can keep you physically active. Taking your pet for walks or playing with them in the yard can help you stay in shape.
